By the end of the fiscal year ending January 31, 2025, we plan to purchase or
generate enough renewable energy to match 100% of our global electricity usage
for our offices and data centers.
Whether it is creation of technology to power next-generation laptops or designs
to support high-performance supercomputers, addressing climate change by
improving energy efficiency is important in our research, development, and
design processes. Read more in Environmental Initiatives and Partnerships.
